plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) C5: no plan instrument shows that reads touched only approved customers. Scope of a call can be asked for during the work from A1 on named read lines, but it costs 10 per line against an allowance of 50, so at most 5 of the 101 reads can be checked. (2) C10: no plan instrument checks that each sending call left its outbox row. Trace of a call is available at A3 on named lines, at 10 per line against the allowance of 50, so at most 5 of the 100 sends can be traced. (3) C3: no instrument checks category against the requester's rule, and the agreement fixes no category value, so the category rule cannot be told from any answer. (4) After promotion no answer reads the live tables; the live state is tied to the staged set only through the promotion line. (5) The A1 undo rehearsal may lapse before A2, which is why the A2 rehearsal is added. (6) Duplicate sending calls are visible only if the sent-as-released answer lists each call, which the plan cannot confirm in advance.
